evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This should take about five to ten minutes of your time. Then we'll be able to build you an accurate code. You can depend on. Sounds good. [Nancy agrees: 'Okay, yes, ma'am.'] — framing present but Rep does not wait for a second affirmation after the probing begins; moves directly into questions.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today? [Asked, but AFTER customer has already begun volunteering info about the move itself — 'Basically, I'm just trying to get a good quote we need to see if we can move Thursday...']
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Jan Hathaway. Moving day: Thursday October 1st → Friday October 2nd. Route: Round Rock, Texas to Huo, Texas. Size: 2000+ sq ft (origin) to 1500 sq ft (destination).
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Property type: two-story (origin) / one-story (destination). Bedrooms: 4 (origin) / 3 (destination). Rooms: living room, dining room, garage, bedrooms all inventoried. Parking: driveway at both locations. Walking distance/access: flat, no steep access concerns except interior stairs. Box count: under 100 (customer estimate), two large console pieces.
evidence_quotes.box_count: Normally based on your home size that is between 115 to 135 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range? [Customer disputes and provides detail: less than 100.]
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_offered: So normally based on your home size, we do a a virtual offer. In that way, we will just base it on the items that we are moving. Do you have time to complete the virtual walkthrough today? [Customer agrees; Rep creates and sends link; call properly transitions to virtual walkthrough.]

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details (parking, access, room-by-room inventory, bedroom count, box count adjustment) and correctly identified a 2000+ sq ft move requiring a virtual walkthrough, then cleanly executed the handoff with a sent link and clear next-step instructions.
coaching_note: Their Agenda question should be asked before any probing begins; here it came after the customer had already started volunteering move details, which weakens discovery discipline and the rep's control of the call flow.
